title: v1.3 Additive Fields for M-Series Certificates
description: Constitutional fields added to every M-series schema in the v1.3 bump. These fields support authority stratification, Cairnmark-to-Stele promotion discipline, reasoning trace separation, and cadence classification.

authority_layer.description: Constitutional invariant CI-3. Bounded above by the lowest authority_layer in upstream evidence per cross-field validation rule authority_layer_bounded_by_inputs. Migration default for v1.2 fixtures: grounded_schema.

promotion_state.description: Constitutional invariant CI-4. State machine specified in Cairnmark-to-Stele transition doctrine. Migration default for v1.2 fixtures is derived from execution_status.

adjudication_authority_layer.description: Adjudication-Plane sign-off cannot occur at commonsense_prior layer.

reasoning_trace_ref.description: Per Cairnmark-to-Stele transition doctrine. Required non-null when promotion_state is promoted_stele or rejected by cross-field rule. Optional when promotion_state is candidate or superseded. Migration default for v1.2 fixtures: null.

cadence_classification.description: Constitutional invariant CI-2. Specifies temporal cadence. Migration default for M-series certificates: mesobeat unless a schema-specific override applies.

stele_expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp. Default null. When set, the Stele transitions to superseded at this timestamp with no successor specified, forcing re-adjudication for continued use.
